prompts.walls: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production videogame texture atlas for Noom. Redraw an original gritty Barony-inspired crypt with classic 1993 Doom material rendering: dense hand-pixelled grain, strong sculpted highlights, muted warm gray stone, near-black crevices, earthy moss, rusty blood red. Square atlas 1024x1024, exactly 2 columns and 2 rows of edge-to-edge square material tiles, NO gaps or borders or text. Reading order: 1 cracked gray dungeon brick wall, staggered large masonry; 2 same brick with dark olive moss; 3 bone-gray crypt masonry with small carved skull frieze integrated horizontally; 4 dark crimson infernal flesh masonry with subtle engraved rune. Orthographic flat diffuse surfaces, no perspective, no scene, no vignette, no lighting gradient across tile. Each tile individually seamless on all edges, same color and masonry height at opposite boundaries. Deliberately coarse pixel art intended to downsample each tile to 64x64, details large enough to remain legible. Original artwork, no copied game assets. Fill entire canvas.

Chunky readable pixels, dark outline, strong volume, limited earthy palette, upper-left highlights. No text, labels, borders, floor, drop shadows, scenery, perspective grid, watermarks or copied game assets. True transparent background. Asset type: animated monster spritesheet. Undead skeleton archer, ivory cracked bones, rusted shoulder armor, dark empty sockets, wooden recurve bow. Narrow gaunt silhouette. Exactly NINE frames in a precisely aligned 3 columns by 3 rows grid covering square canvas, equal square cells, read left-to-right top-to-bottom. Each pose centered horizontally within its cell, no overlap, at least 8 percent clear gutter. All upright poses same scale and ground baseline 92 percent down each cell. Front-facing full body at player eye level. Frame sequence: row 1 idle standing, walk left leg forward, walk right leg forward; row 2 draw bow aiming, release arrow shooting, recoil in pain; row 3 dying knees buckling, collapsing sideways, dead flattened corpse ON THE SAME BASELINE at bottom of cell. Last corpse must be low and wide, not standing. No extra frames. Designed to resize each frame to 32x48 pixels, so details must be bold.

prompts.surfaces: Use case: stylized-concept. Production texture atlas for original Noom dungeon game in a Barony plus classic 1993 Doom style, gritty dense pixel art, strong sculpted bevels, dark earthy warm stone palette, intended for 64x64 pixel tiles. EXACT 4 columns and 2 rows edge-to-edge square tiles, canvas landscape 2:1, no margins no gaps no borders no labels. Row 1 left to right: gray worn dungeon flagstone floor; same floor with dark red blood stains; black-red infernal floor glowing fine lava cracks; dark soot-stained stone ceiling. Row 2: wooden vertical plank door with riveted dark iron bands; matching wooden door with prominent blue iron bands and large blue keyhole; gothic stone exit gateway containing violet swirling magical portal; dark iron door track surface vertical metal rails. Flat orthographic diffuse surfaces only, no scene, no perspective, no vignette. First four tile surfaces seamless on opposite edges, masonry at shared boundaries aligned, flat diffuse lighting. Original artwork, no copied assets.

Consistent hands, rusty metal bright scratches dark wood, bold chunky pixels readable at 80x80 per frame. No text no outlines of grid no floor no shadows no labels no copied game art.
